title: Town Board Work Session agenda packet, October 15, 2026 (excerpt)
note: Text of the pages /budget-amendments-2027/ cites, extracted with PyMuPDF from the agenda packet of the Town Board's October 15, 2026 work session on CivicClerk. The packet carries the pre-final draft agenda and resolutions for the October 20, 2026 regular meeting, among them six amendments to the 2027 Preliminary Budget. Keys are packet page numbers.

VII.6.  
 
TOWN OF RIVERHEAD 
 
TB Resolution  
 
AUTHORIZES AMENDMENT #1 TO THE 2027 PRELIMINARY BUDGET 
 
None offered the following resolution,  
which was seconded by None 
 
 
WHEREAS, upon review of the 2027 Tentative Budget, the Town Board wishes to make 
additional reductions to the property tax levy for 2027 and 
 
WHEREAS, several one-time expenditures were identified in the budget which can be 
removed from the budget and instead funded with General Fund balance via the submission of 
separate Town Board resolutions in 2027. Now, therefore be it 
 
RESOLVED, that the Town Board hereby authorizes the following adjustments to the 
2027 Preliminary Budget: 
  
FROM                    TO 
 
A01-1-1625-240-000-00000  B&G Equipment                 $53,300 
A01-3-3410-240-000-00000  Fire Marshal Equipment     $50,000 
A01-8-8160-280-000-00000  Refuse Vehicles                 $55,000 
A01-1001-001-00000-A  Property Taxes                                                $158,300 
 
And be it further 
 
RESOLVED, that the Town Clerk is hereby authorized to forward a copy of this resolution 
to the Engineering Department, the Fire Marshal Department, and 
finance@townofriverheadny.gov, and be it further 
 
RESOLVED, all Town Hall Departments may review and obtain a copy of this resolution 
from the electronic storage device and, if needed, a certified copy of the same may be obtained 
from the Office of the Town Clerk. 
 
 
 
THE VOTE 
 
RESULT: 
 
MOVER: 
None 
SECONDER: None 
AYES: 
None 
NAYS: 
None
